# Fictional backup fixtures

`legacy_v22_export.json` contains no rider records. It was generated from the preserved V2.3 web application's `web/domain.mjs`, `web/earnings.mjs` and `web/storage.mjs` using their actual `normalize`, `validate` and `saveState` functions. Its top-level `exportedAt` field follows `exportJSON` in `web/app.js`. The original archive remains unchanged in the engineering workspace.

The itemized example has PHP 1,000 jobs + 50 tip + 100 bonus - 20 adjustment = 1,130 earnings. At 100 km, 40 km/L, PHP 65/L, PHP 80 other costs and PHP 1/km reserve, fuel is PHP 162.50, cash remainder is PHP 887.50 and after-reserve remainder is PHP 787.50. The other records distinguish unknown costs from deliberate zero.

These are test fixtures, not preloaded application history or evidence about real rider earnings.
